title: Onboarding - Development Guidelines
content:
This documentation aim to provide instructions and information on how to start working in the project.
It should be seen as a guide to the minimum required documentation, each project is unique and might need additional topics to get started.

Source code

This part should give information on how to check out the code, work with the code, etc.

Checking out the code

This section should contain information on how to view and check out the source code. It should list all prerequisites, e.g. if an IKEA account is needed.

It should clearly state who to contact to gain access to the source code, and direct links to the repository.

Basic understanding of Git can be assumed.

Working with the code

This section should describe what structures and processes that are in place when working with the code and making changes.

It should clearly describe:

  • Branch strategy (git workflow) that the team is using (see )
  • Requirements regarding pull-requests and code reviews
  • how commit messages should be structured.

Testing

Running tests

This section should clearly describe how to run automatic tests on the local development machine. If that is not possible it should state that.
All tools needed should be listed with basic installation and configuration instructions.

Adding new tests

This section should add information how to add new test cases and the expectations on adding tests when developing bug fixes and features.

Testing in QA

There should be clear instructions on how to deploy to QA and run tests against that stage. If deployment to QA is done automatically, e.g. on merge, that should be stated.

Instructions on how to start and run automatic tests against the QA stage should exist. If tests are triggered automatically that should be stated.

Tools

All tool needed during development and testing should be listed here.

Installation and configuration instructions should be available for all local tools.

All online tools, e.g. Jira, should be listed with direct links and instructions on how to contact to get access.
